source: Original review expense-ledger-map.json; all 50 records retained below with additive revision mapping. Original audit files were not edited.

entries.calculation: Active business plan minutes, including authorized extra usage, × escalated per-minute rate; monthly
entries.cashTiming: Same month; no provider settlement lag
entries.overlap: Do not add retellCost again to directProviderCosts; trials, grace usage and concurrency are not explicitly budgeted.
entries.revisionTiming: Same month; no provider settlement lag
entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Active businesses × per-business rate × AI escalation; monthly
entries.overlap: Zero does not verify free AI; avoid duplicating AI included in Retell rate.
entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Active businesses × phone allowance; monthly
entries.group: Variable in current model; commitment depends on actual number contract
entries.overlap: Business count is a proxy for phone numbers; avoid duplicate telephony already in voice rate.
entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Active businesses × allowance × hosting/storage escalation; monthly
entries.overlap: Separate metered portion from committed infrastructure and the original $300.
entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Active businesses × allowance; monthly
entries.overlap: Not a message-volume forecast; check provider bundles.

entries.calculation: Active businesses × allowance; monthly

entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Gross collections × processing rate + successful payments × fixed fee
entries.accounting: Modeled direct cost; not a revenue deduction
entries.overlap: Annual payments incur annual collection-based fees; avoid adding a second CAC/payment expense.
entries.revisionStatus: Mapped to canonical operating ledger or revenue adjustment

entries.calculation: Gross collections × Billing rate
entries.overlap: Distinct from card processing only if this product is actually used/charged.

entries.calculation: Modeled refund/chargeback reductions to recognized revenue and collections

entries.accounting: Simplified contra revenue, not an extra operating cost
entries.overlap: Do not subtract as expense again; explicit dispute fees/fee-refund behavior require contract evidence.
entries.revisionAuthority: refundsChargebacks (contra revenue and net collections; not a second expense)

entries.calculation: Enabled direct channel monthly budget

entries.calculation: Monthly spend creates demand by one selected method: spend/CAC or spend/CPL × funnel

entries.revisionTiming: Monthly; not automatically proportional to realized customers

entries.calculation: Realized referral additions × reward

entries.calculation: Realized partner additions × commission

entries.calculation: Manual pay or milestone compensation floor, with modeled escalation

entries.calculation: Active employee FTE × base pay; separate burden percentage; approval/start/end schedule

entries.calculation: Per-hire override, otherwise equipment + recruitment default, × new FTE at start
